detail: tryCompileExpression() is documented non-throwing and returns a boolean, but threw: _EngineError: Unterminated string literal: "1y\=
note: Replayed clean: tryCompileExpression() now guards its body and returns false rather than letting a parse error out. Kept as a regression case, and marked fixed because an open entry silences every finding that signs the same way, which for this wording is every contract violation the expression generator can produce.
